remote_index.title: Remote directory cache
remote_index.description: Refreshes only parent directories already tracked by Writeback. Results are stored in MySQL for exact same-name, size and SHA-1 comparisons. The configured concurrency is an upper bound; every 115 API request follows the storage backend's LimitRate.
remote_index.already_running: Remote cache refresh is already running
remote_index.unavailable: Remote cache refresh could not start during rebuild
remote_index.confirm_refresh: Refresh all tracked parent directories on 115 now? This sends Fresh LIST requests and may create significant API traffic.
remote_index.confirm_refresh_again: Start the remote refresh? It will send requests to 115 and may trigger its rate limits.

active.description: Cloud Sync PUTs are durably spooled and ACKed first. A recent MySQL remote-index match is checked before Fresh LIST; either can skip the upload when any same-name file has the same size and SHA-1. Otherwise OpenList uploads the spool. Temporary errors keep the spool and retry in Processing.
active.confirm_batch_reupload: Directly re-upload the selected tasks from the durable local spool. Count:
active.confirm_pause_all: Pause all pausable active tasks? In-flight uploads will stop as soon as possible while keeping the durable local spool.
active.confirm_reupload_all: Immediately re-upload every eligible task to the provider from the durable local spool? Exact existing 115 content is checked first.
active.confirm_cancel_one: Fail this task and abandon the current local payload? WebDAV will expose the path as missing so Cloud Sync can automatically upload a fresh generation.
active.confirm_cancel_selected: Fail the selected tasks and return them to Cloud Sync. Count:
active.confirm_cancel_all: Fail all active file tasks? Their WebDAV paths will be exposed as missing so Cloud Sync can automatically upload fresh generations.
active.failed_auto_reupload: Confirmation failed; waiting for automatic Cloud Sync re-upload
active.confirm_start_all: Start every paused writeback task? This may trigger many provider uploads and API requests.
active.confirm_reupload_one: Schedule a re-upload of this task from the local spool? This may upload the full file again.

history.delete_description: Deletes only WebDAVWritebackHistory audit rows. It cannot change current canonical state, spool/provider data, or trigger re-upload. Set retention days to 0 to delete all matching rows immediately.
history.confirm_selected: Delete selected History rows only. Count:
history.success_age_required: Successful History cleanup requires a positive age.
history.confirm_class_safety: Current canonical/spool/provider state is untouched; 0 days means immediate cleanup.
history.status_description: Final Status is the operator-facing answer. Raw historical result, recovery type and old errors are retained under Advanced for audit only.
history.older_than_days_hint: 0 means no age limit and deletes all matching history rows immediately.

settings.title: Writeback settings
settings.description: Cloud Sync PUTs are durably spooled and ACKed first. A recent MySQL remote-index snapshot can skip an upload on an exact same-name, size and SHA-1 match; otherwise OpenList uses a fresh 115 listing. Provider API success completes the task. Temporary errors keep the spool in Processing and retry with backoff.
settings.upload_workers_hint: The same concurrency limit applies to every file size. It cannot exceed Workers.
settings.provider_probe_workers_hint: Caps simultaneous directory probes. The selected storage backend's LimitRate controls the actual 115 request pace. A restart is required after changing this setting.
settings.provider_snapshot_ttl_hint: -1 = disable cached provider listings and Writeback remote index matches
settings.confirm_disable: Disable WebDAV writeback? This may prevent new Cloud Sync uploads from being handled by this service.

rebuild.title: Full rebuild / gap check
rebuild.description: Rebuild runs in the background. Current PUTs finish first; GET, HEAD, and PROPFIND remain available, while new writes get 503 with Retry-After. OpenList clears its writeback records, cached remote index and local .part/.data spool files, including orphans. It never deletes 115 files. A fresh 115 listing that finds any same-name file with matching size and SHA-1 completes without another upload.
rebuild.confirm: Start a full rebuild? OpenList will clear its writeback records and local spool files after current PUTs finish. Files on 115 will not be deleted; new Cloud Sync writes will retry later.
rebuild.started: Full rebuild started in the background.
rebuild.already_running: A full rebuild is already running.

reconciliation.title: One-time Cloud Sync inventory
reconciliation.description: OpenList cannot scan Cloud Sync's private local directory. This separate workflow builds a metadata-only inventory from Cloud Sync PUT and MKCOL requests, then compares it with 115. Upload bodies are streamed through SHA-1 and discarded without using the Writeback spool. Fresh LIST runs one directory at a time and follows the storage backend's LimitRate.

steps.collect_description: Choose a WebDAV directory and start collection. Cloud Sync will see an empty directory; PUT bodies are hashed and discarded.
steps.compare_description: After Cloud Sync finishes its scan, close collection. OpenList Fresh LISTs one 115 directory at a time and follows the storage rate limit. Nothing is deleted during comparison.
steps.review_description: Review the 115-only or mismatching candidates before confirming deletion. Then finish the task to expose missing paths to Cloud Sync for its next normal upload.

reconciliation.root_required: Enter an existing, non-root WebDAV directory.
reconciliation.confirm_start: Start inventory mode for this directory? WebDAV will show an empty directory to Cloud Sync, so run its full scan now.
reconciliation.confirm_start_again: Confirm again: PUT content will only be hashed and discarded until this task is finished.
reconciliation.started: Inventory mode started. Run a full Cloud Sync scan for this directory.

instructions.collecting: Cloud Sync sees an empty directory. Let its full scan finish. PUT and MKCOL requests add paths and metadata here; file contents are discarded after hashing and are not recoverable from OpenList.
instructions.comparing: Collection is closed. OpenList is Fresh LISTing each 115 directory sequentially. API errors pause comparison and never authorize deletion.
instructions.compare_failed: No 115 files were deleted. Retry the comparison after a temporary API/rate-limit issue, or cancel safely to mark received paths missing for Cloud Sync to resend.
instructions.preview: Review the listed extra or mismatching 115 paths. Deletion happens only after the two confirmations below.
instructions.deleting: OpenList rechecks each affected 115 directory and removes reviewed paths sequentially. This task can resume after a restart.
instructions.delete_failed: Some deletions may already have succeeded. Retry deletion, or compare again to rebuild the preview before continuing.
instructions.ready: 115 extras are cleared. Finish to publish the Cloud Sync inventory in Writeback; missing files will then appear absent to Cloud Sync.
instructions.completed: Normal WebDAV is restored. Trigger Cloud Sync's next scan; missing paths will use the ordinary Writeback upload flow.
instructions.canceled: The task stopped without deleting 115 objects. Received paths are missing in WebDAV; run Cloud Sync again to resend them.

reconciliation.confirm_collection_end: Finish collection and start sequential Fresh LIST comparison with 115? No 115 objects will be deleted yet.
reconciliation.confirm_compare_again: Run the comparison again using the saved Cloud Sync inventory? This sends new Fresh LIST requests to 115.
reconciliation.confirm_collection_end_again: Confirm the comparison. Each directory is listed one at a time and obeys the storage backend rate limit.
reconciliation.confirm_delete: Delete all reviewed 115 candidates? Candidate count:
reconciliation.confirm_delete_again: Confirm permanent removal of these 115 paths. OpenList will verify each affected directory afterward.
reconciliation.finish: Restore normal WebDAV and publish inventory
reconciliation.confirm_finish: Finish this task and make Cloud Sync inventory authoritative in WebDAV? Missing paths will be returned as absent.
reconciliation.confirm_finish_again: Confirm. After this step, run Cloud Sync again so missing files enter the normal upload flow.
reconciliation.finished: Normal Writeback is restored. Run Cloud Sync's next scan for missing files.
reconciliation.confirm_cancel: Stop this task before 115 deletion? No remote files will be deleted; received paths will be marked missing so Cloud Sync can resend them.
reconciliation.confirm_cancel_again: Confirm. WebDAV will return the received paths as missing; run Cloud Sync again to resend them.
reconciliation.canceled: Task canceled. Run Cloud Sync again for the received paths.

errors.missing_sha1: 115 returned a same-name file without a usable SHA-1. Comparison stopped safely.
errors.storage_changed: The storage mapping changed. No further remote deletion was attempted.
errors.candidate_changed: A reviewed path changed. Compare again before continuing.
errors.remote_list: 115 could not provide a fresh directory listing. No unverified paths were deleted.
errors.remote_delete: 115 deletion did not finish. Review the task and retry when ready.
errors.invalid_root: Choose an existing directory on exactly one 115 storage, without nested mounts.
errors.busy: Writeback is busy. Wait for active requests to finish, then retry.
errors.task_active: Another inventory task is already active.
errors.request_failed: The request could not be completed. Refresh the task status and retry.
